if (!document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-waiting-link][href="#/todo?filter=same_song"]')) throw new Error('the waiting answers link to To-do\'s questions')

if (/OFFLINE/.test(document.querySelector('[data-page-header] [data-read-status]').textContent) || document.querySelector('[data-test=read-problem] button')) throw new Error("offline said or retried twice on Sync (\u00a75a/\u00a711)")

const n = document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-rekordbox-open]'); const start = document.querySelector('[data-test=start-sync]'); if (n.textContent.replace(/^\s*\u26a0\s*/, '').trim() !== 'rekordbox is open: quit it before the sync ends, so the sync can put 4 upgrades in place.') throw new Error('the before-start note says 4 upgrades in rekordbox\'s words: ' + n.textContent); if (!(start.compareDocumentPosition(n) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_PRECEDING) || document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-console], [data-test=sync-nothing-today], [data-test=sync-auto-plan]')) throw new Error('the warning sits above Start sync, so the button does not jump when rekordbox quits, and no plan Hint stands beside it'); if (document.querySelectorAll('[data-primary]').length !== 1) throw new Error('Start sync stays the one filled button')

if (document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-rekordbox-open]')) throw new Error('rekordbox is closed: no warning'); const h = document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-auto-plan]'); if (!h || h.textContent.trim() !== '13 upgrades go in at the end; cues stay.' || h.scrollWidth > h.clientWidth + 1) throw new Error('rekordbox is closed: the plan Hint under Start sync says what the end does, in one uncut line: ' + (h && h.textContent)); if (!(document.querySelector('[data-test=start-sync]').compareDocumentPosition(h) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING)) throw new Error('the Hint sits under Start sync')

if (!/Spotify isn't connected/.test(document.querySelector('[data-test=read-problem]').textContent)) throw new Error("Sync must say a missing Spotify login in its card (\u00a711)")
if (document.querySelector('[data-test=banner-read-status]')) throw new Error("the banner repeats Sync's card (\u00a711)")

if (document.querySelector('[data-test=read-read]').getAttribute('aria-disabled') !== 'true') throw new Error("Read Spotify must be off without a login (\u00a75a)")

if (!document.querySelector('[data-frame=column] [data-test=sync-progress]') || !document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-chips] [role=radio]')) throw new Error('the running view is on ColumnFrame with its progress card and a Segmented filter (spec \u00a78)')

if (document.querySelector('[data-test=card-from]').textContent.trim() !== "SoundCloud · the playlist's own upload" || /SOUNDCLOUD|YT MUSIC/i.test(document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-card] .kicker').textContent)) throw new Error('the source leaves the kicker for its own line (sources round row 15)')

(async () => { const img = document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-card] img'); if (!img) throw new Error('The live card shows no picture for a track whose file has artwork'); await new Promise((r) => (img.complete ? r() : img.addEventListener('load', r))); })()
window.__c1 = document.querySelector('[data-test=pause-cover]').textContent
if (window.__c1 === document.querySelector('[data-test=pause-cover]').textContent) throw new Error('countdown frozen')
document.querySelector('[data-frame-main]').scrollTop = 1e6
document.querySelector('[data-frame-main]').scrollTop = 1e6

const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-test=sync-item]')]; const bare = rows.filter((r) => !r.querySelector('[data-test=sync-kind] svg')); if (bare.length) throw new Error(bare.length + ' plan rows without their kind icon (issue 35)'); const kinds = new Set(rows.map((r) => r.querySelector('[data-test=sync-kind]').dataset.kind)); if (kinds.size !== 5) throw new Error('sync:many should hold all 5 kinds, got ' + [...kinds].join())
document.querySelectorAll('[data-test=browser-switch][data-place=playlists][aria-checked=true]').forEach((b) => b.click())

if (!/switched off/.test(document.querySelector('[data-test=day-bar-empty]')?.textContent ?? '')) throw new Error('the empty day bar must say why (issue 36): ' + document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-daybar]')?.textContent + ' / plan: ' + [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-test=sync-plan] [data-folder]')].map((e) => e.dataset.folder).join())

const k = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-test=sync-scope-kind]')].map((r) => r.dataset.key); if (k.join() !== 'retry,weekly') throw new Error('Weekly checks should hold both switches (issue 36), got ' + k.join()); if (!document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-kind][data-kind=weekly]')) throw new Error('a weekly check row without its clock')
if (!document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-scope-kind][data-key=weekly]')) throw new Error('the Weekly checks switch went with its rows')
document.querySelector('[data-folder=Peak_Time_Warmup_Selection_2026_Final_v3]').scrollIntoView()
document.querySelectorAll('[data-test=sync-section-none]').forEach((b) => b.click())
if (document.querySelector('[data-test=browser-all], [data-test=browser-unlisted]')) throw new Error('Sync\'s column must not lead to Library (issue 37): All tracks / Not in a playlist are left out')
const b = document.querySelector('[data-test=browser-folder-switch][data-place=folders]'); if (b?.getAttribute('aria-checked') !== 'false') throw new Error('the folder switch should be off')
if (document.querySelector('[data-test=browser-handoff]') || !document.querySelector('[data-test=browser-switch]')) throw new Error('on Sync the filter finds switches and has no hand-off (issue 37)')

const c = document.querySelector('[data-test=browser-folder-switch].indent'); if (!c || (c.getAttribute('aria-checked') !== 'false' || c.getAttribute('aria-disabled') !== 'true')) throw new Error('a crate under a folder switched off shows off and cannot switch (issue 37)')
document.querySelector('[data-test=browser-list]').scrollTop = 1e6

if (document.querySelector('[data-test=read-reading]') || !document.querySelector('[data-page-header] [data-test=read-stop]')) throw new Error("Sync's header must hold only Stop reading while reading (\u00a75a)")
const n = document.body.innerText.split('Stopping').length - 1; if (n !== 1) throw new Error('Stopping is said once, in the title (\u00a711), not ' + n + ' times')

const pos = document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-position]').textContent.trim(); const msg = document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-message]')?.textContent.trim() ?? ''; if (pos !== '3 of 8 upgraded' || !/^Upgrading · .+/.test(msg)) throw new Error('the progress card counts the upgraded tracks, not Track x of y: ' + pos + ' / ' + msg); if (document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-card]')) throw new Error('no live card in the upgrade phase: the progress card carries it'); if (!document.querySelector('[data-test=stop-safely]')) throw new Error('Stop safely stays in the foot')

if (document.querySelectorAll('[data-primary]').length !== 1 || !document.querySelector('[data-frame-foot] [data-test=sync-done-button][data-primary]')) throw new Error('Done is the one filled button, in the foot (spec \u00a78)'); const up = document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-auto-upgrade-list]'); if (!up || up.querySelectorAll('[data-test=end-row]').length !== 1 || !/^Upgraded 1 track; your cues stayed\.$/.test(document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-auto-upgrade]').textContent.trim())) throw new Error('the normal run upgrades one track at its end (Upgraded 1)')

const list = document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-auto-upgrade-list]'); const note = document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-auto-upgrade]'); if (!list || !note) throw new Error('the end screen holds the Auto-upgrade note and list'); if (!/^Upgraded 9 tracks; your cues stayed\. 3 wait for rekordbox to be closed\. 1 couldn.t go in; To-do says why\.$/.test(note.textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' '))) throw new Error('the note is the run\'s line: ' + note.textContent); const heads = [list.querySelector('.head'), ...list.querySelectorAll('[data-list-section]')].map((h) => h.textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ')); if (heads.join('|') !== 'Upgraded 9|Still waiting 3|Couldn\'t go in 1') throw new Error('Upgraded, Still waiting, Couldn\'t go in, with counts: ' + heads.join('|')); const rows = [...list.querySelectorAll('[data-test=end-row]')]; if (rows.length !== 13) throw new Error('13 rows in the list'); const sub = (r) => r.querySelector('.sub'); const cut = rows.filter((r) => sub(r) && sub(r).scrollWidth > sub(r).clientWidth + 1); if (cut.length) throw new Error('no second line is cut by an ellipsis: ' + cut.map((r) => sub(r).textContent).join(' / ')); if (rows.slice(9, 12).some((r) => !r.querySelector('[data-test=end-review]') || sub(r).textContent.trim() !== 'Waits for rekordbox to be closed')) throw new Error('3 waiting rows: Waits for rekordbox to be closed, Review →'); if (!rows[12].querySelector('[data-test=end-fix]') || sub(rows[12]).textContent.trim() !== 'Couldn\'t line it up' || !/nothing was changed/.test(sub(rows[12]).querySelector('span').title)) throw new Error('the refused row: To-do\'s short reason, the full sentence as its tooltip, Fix →'); if (new Set(rows.slice(0, 9).map((r) => sub(r).textContent.trim())).size < 3) throw new Error('the Upgraded rows say how each went (and the kept edit), not one repeated line'); if (document.querySelector('[data-test=todo-pill]')?.textContent.trim() !== '16') throw new Error('the To-do badge counts 16 rows after this sync (5 ready: 3 wait + 1 refused + the one that needs a choice; the 9 upgraded are one check card)'); if (document.querySelectorAll('[data-primary]').length !== 1) throw new Error('Done is the one filled button')
document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-auto-upgrade-list]').scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' })

const list = document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-auto-upgrade-list]'); if (!list) throw new Error('the waiting tracks have their list'); const heads = [list.querySelector('.head'), ...list.querySelectorAll('[data-list-section]')].map((h) => h.textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ')); if (heads.join('|') !== 'Still waiting 4') throw new Error('only Still waiting (the empty Upgraded part is left out): ' + heads.join('|')); const wrows = [...list.querySelectorAll('[data-test=end-row]')]; if (wrows.length !== 4 || wrows.some((r) => r.querySelector('.sub').textContent.trim() !== 'Waits for rekordbox to be closed' || !r.querySelector('[data-test=end-review]'))) throw new Error('4 waiting rows with their short reason and Review →'); if (document.querySelector('[data-test=todo-pill]')?.textContent.trim() !== '20') throw new Error('the To-do badge counts 20 rows after this sync (the phase added none; the sync own download is the 20th)'); if (!/^4 upgrades wait for rekordbox to be closed\.$/.test(document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-auto-upgrade]').textContent.trim())) throw new Error('the note says all 4 wait')
document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-auto-upgrade-list]').scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' })
if (![...document.querySelectorAll('[data-test=sync-failed] button')].some((b) => b.textContent.includes('Open report'))) throw new Error('The crash card opens its own crash note (Open report)')
if (document.querySelector('[data-test=stop-hint]')) throw new Error('The stop error replaces the hint')

if (!/Qobuz isn't connected/.test(document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-failed]').textContent) || !document.querySelector('[data-test=sync-failed] [href$=qobuz]')) throw new Error('the failed sync names Qobuz and links its Settings card')
